what: Linde is the world's largest industrial gas company. It separates air into oxygen, nitrogen and argon, makes hydrogen and other gases, and delivers them by pipeline, truck or cylinder.
customers: Chemical plants, refineries, steelmakers, chipmakers, hospitals and food producers.
money: industrial gases in North and South America
moat: Long contracts with minimum volumes, plants built next to customers and high local market share make earnings unusually steady.
opportunities: Operating margin of 26%, the best among industrial gas companies
Long-term on-site contracts with built-in price increases make revenue very predictable
A project backlog of new plants already contracted with customers
watch: Pricing growth and the contracted project backlog.
